name: crawl-readiness
description: Check whether AI crawlers can read a website and what its access policy allows, whether a page permits an AI use, generate llms.txt, robots.txt and JSON-LD, and read your Answer Analysis.

crawl_readiness_api_key.title: Crawl Readiness API key
crawl_readiness_api_key.description: Optional. The five checks (the four audit tools and the permission check) work without it. A free key from https://www.crawlreadiness.com/dashboard unlocks the three generators and lifts the permission check's daily limit. Reading an Answer Analysis needs a key on a plan that includes one (Monitor, Agency or the audit).
